description: This file defines a React functional component 'RecommendationGrid' which fetches and displays a grid of recommended roles based on a persona ID. It manages loading, error, and empty states, and renders role cards with accordion behavior. It also optionally provides a button for career analysis.

methods.name: RecommendationGrid
methods.description: React functional component that fetches role recommendations for a given persona and renders them in a grid with optional analysis button.
